args.body: For the existing Lemon Squeezy mission, reuse any committed verdict. If the queued payout fee evidence commits, verify the passage against the original and combine it with any governing payout evidence already collected. Make the private launch decision using the number of USD 15 sales needed to reach the documented payout threshold, if verified, and the first payout charge under one supported Canadian method. Keep tax, conversion, refunds and operating costs unknown where evidence is missing. If payout eligibility or rights for an exact archive member remain unsupported, close under your actual lease after reading back the decision evidence, with a lesson and the exact evidence that would reopen the route. Any public listing remains subject to host-enforced independent review.
